item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.0

  • Automatic updates. ShawNotch now checks for new versions by itself and installs them in a click. You can turn the daily check off in Settings.
  • Music Mode on macOS 14 and 15. It puts the album poster on your desktop. Colouring icons, widgets and folders still needs macOS 26.
  • Full-screen apps. Their title bar no longer stays down after you've used the notch.
